entries.title: Apache Airflow

timeline.description: Possible replacement for ctrl-m, first experiments being performed at customer tech and engineering enablement.

entries.title: Azure OpenAI
entries.description: Advanced language AI service provided by Azure supporting OpenAI GPT-4, Codex, and DALL-E models.

timeline.description: Will be assess during the Scan je recept Labs pilot.

entries.title: Apache Flink
entries.description: Open Source stream processing framework.

entries.title: Bicep
entries.description: Bicep is a Domain Specific Language (DSL) for deploying Azure resources declaratively.

entries.title: BizzDesign
entries.description: BizzDesign is a tool that helps you to create a business model canvas.

entries.title: Cilium
entries.description: Cilium is an open source software for providing, securing and observing network connectivity between container workloads - cloud native, and fueled by the revolutionary Kernel technology eBPF.

timeline.description: Will be assessed in Kubernetes as a Service to replace Kubenet to reduce network hops, and allow us to test the other features.

entries.title: Commvault-Metallic
entries.description: Commvault Metallic is a cloud-based backup solution that is used for use cases that are not supported by the native backup service provided by the Cloud Service Provider. For onboarding to this service please contact [Cloud Enablement Team](https://github.com/orgs/RoyalAholdDelhaize/discussions/categories/cloud).

timeline.description: Commvault Metallic replaces the existing Commvault IaaS solution, which is mainly in use for Oracle Databases on Azure and OCVS in Oracle Cloud.

entries.title: Confluence
entries.description: Confluence is a proprietary enterprise wiki used for documenting, discussing, and organizing a project's work with its users. It is developed by Atlassian and is available as a cloud-based software as a service (SaaS) product or as an on-premises installation.

entries.title: Azure Databricks
entries.description: Azure Databricks is a cloud-based unified analytics platform that combines Apache Spark with a collaborative workspace to help users accelerate data processing, machine learning workflows, and data-driven decision-making.

timeline.description: Azure Databricks is the preferred solution for data processing and machine learning

entries.title: Defender for Containers
entries.description: Microsoft Defender for Containers is the cloud-native solution that is used to secure your containers so you can improve, monitor, and maintain the security of your clusters, containers, and their applications.

timeline.description: Defender for Containers is being trialed at the Cloud Core team from TechNL.

entries.title: DevPod
entries.description: Open Source Dev-Environments-As-Code (Daes). Open Source tool for Devcontainers. Viable alternative for codespaces as it runs client-only. Enables creating reproducible developer environments in containers and is specified through devcontainer.json.

timeline.description: Open Source Dev-Environments-As-Code (Daes). Open Source tool for Devcontainers. Viable alternative for codespaces as it runs client-only. Enables creating reproducible developer environments in containers and is specified through devcontainer.json.

entries.title: Docker Desktop
entries.description: Docker Desktop is a proprietary solution to run containers on your local workstation.

timeline.description: Free alternatives are available, such as Podman Desktop, Rancher Desktop, Colima and Minikube.

entries.title: Docs-like-code
entries.description: Docs-like-code is an approach to creating and maintaining documentation that treats documentation as code, using version control, testing, and automated deployment.

entries.title: Force push to master
entries.description: Force push to the main branch is a bad practice and lead to a higher risk of defect code in production

timeline.description: Force push to the main branch is a bad practice and lead to a higher risk of defect code in production

entries.title: GitHub Copilot
entries.description: GitHub Copilot uses the OpenAI Codex to suggest code and entire functions in real-time, right from your editor.

timeline.description: Copilot is adopted by multiple teams across TechNL to increase developer productivity.
A Pilot will start in Tech NL to evaluate Copilot for a variety of scenarios.

entries.title: IntelliJ IDEA
entries.description: IntelliJ IDEA is an integrated development environment (IDE) written in Java for developing computer software. It is developed by JetBrains (formerly known as IntelliJ), and is available as an Apache 2 Licensed community edition, and in a proprietary commercial edition.

entries.title: Grafana Loki
entries.description: Grafana Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system.

timeline.description: Grafana Loki is part of the TechNL observability platform 'Cerebro', this is the primary platform for all observability data.

entries.title: Grafana Mimir
entries.description: Grafana Mimir is an open source, horizontally scalable, highly available, multi-tenant TSDB for long-term storage for Prometheus.

timeline.description: Grafana Loki is part of the TechNL observability platform 'Cerebro', this is the primary platform for all observability data.

entries.title: Mulesoft
entries.description: Mulesoft is an integration platform that allows businesses to connect different applications and systems to streamline data exchange and communication.

timeline.description: Mulesoft is an integration platform rather than a tool, and is no longer a preferred solution. Existing integrations can continue, no new integrations should be built on it.
Mulesoft is still one of the preferred solution for integration, but Kotlin and Kafka is preferred over Mulesoft

entries.title: OpenShift Container Platform
entries.description: OpenShift is a container application platform that allows developers to build, deploy, and manage applications in a cloud-based environment.

timeline.description: OpenShift is not the preferred solution for container hosting, please use AKS (KaaS)

entries.title: Poly API
entries.description: Poly is the go-to platform for developer teams looking to simplify their API and Event discovery and consumption. Experience seamless integration, satisfy your development partners, and unlock the potential of LLM AI Agents—all through the power of Poly.

entries.title: Roadmunk
entries.description: Roadmunk is a product management tool that helps you to create a business model canvas.

entries.title: Thanos
entries.description: Open source, highly available Prometheus setup with long term storage capabilities

entries.title: Unleash
entries.description: Unleash is an open-source feature management platform that allows developers to seamlessly manage feature flags in their applications.

timeline.description: Unleash could be used as a standardised solution to replace the current custom implemented feature toggle systems across the organisation.

entries.title: webMethods iPaaS Trading Networks
entries.description: webMethods iPaaS is a cloud-native integration platform designed for Trading Networks and B2B integrations. It provides a scalable, managed solution for securely connecting trading partners and automating business processes. With Hybrid Link, it supports Edge Nodes for secure, low-latency data processing, enabling seamless hybrid connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.

timeline.description: The scope for WebM iPaas is currently for EDI integration only.
